reviewMethod: Actual V2 source, previous atlas, new full candidate and all four nearest2x neutral-gray quadrants were visually inspected.
Gray quadrants are display-only true alpha composites; no production image or semantic pixels were painted.
All16frames visible in reviewed quadrants;14initiallyaccepted,03and12then genuinely redrawn and accepted separately.
Two replacements then actually inspected; all16final cell images verified equal to exact256px candidate cells, and complete corrected atlas viewed after true alpha compositing.
observations: Short black ornamented textured locks, gold/turquoise circlet, continuous ivory chest-to-waist drape, blue/gold collar and center panel, sandals and left-hip pouch replace documented old midriff/long-hair unarmed divergence.
Khopsesh retained in anatomical right or both hands, no extra body parts or proven profile laterality reversal; leftward walking poses allow ordinary near/far-arm occlusion.
Strong red contours in transparent viewer disappear in proper alpha compositing; these are not a red costume or semantic extra limb. Tiny opaque warm pixels include normal skin/metal shading.
Existing packing geometry and baseline claims belong to technical producer proof, not inferred by visual inspection alone.
